name: docker-pane
description: A Docker chip above the prompt and a Dracula-themed containers pane grouped by compose project: ports, health, Start/Stop/Restart by container name, logs and compose Recreate in the app's Terminal, and a warning when a container is older than your last git checkout.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the containers are read while the pane is closed; the open pane refreshes every 10 s.

dockerPath.title: docker path
dockerPath.description: Full path to docker when it is not on the PATH Claude Code sees.
